title: Fermat ProbCover: Coverage-Based Active Learning on Fermat Distance Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.13448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Active learning aims to reduce annotation cost by selecting the most informative examples for labeling. In the low-budget regime, where uncertainty-based methods often fail, coverage-based active learning methods such as ProbCover have been shown to be effective. However, these methods typically rely on Euclidean distance, which may not adequately capture the underlying geometry of data. In this article, we propose PC-Fermat, a coverage-based active learning method that replaces Euclidean coverage neighborhoods with neighborhoods defined by a Fermat distance, i.e., a data-adaptive distance that reflects the underlying distribution of the data points. To facilitate computation, we construct a weighted Euclidean neighborhood graph and use a truncated shortest-path algorithm to compute the Fermat coverage graph. translated_title: 费马ProbCover：基于费马距离图的覆盖式主动学习
translated_abstract: 主动学习旨在通过选择最具信息量的样本进行标注来降低标注成本。在低预算场景下，基于不确定性的方法往往失效，而ProbCover等基于覆盖的主动学习方法已被证明是有效的。然而，这些方法通常依赖于欧氏距离，而欧氏距离可能无法充分捕捉数据的底层几何结构。在本文中，我们提出了PC-Fermat，这是一种基于覆盖的主动学习方法，它用由费马距离定义的邻域取代了欧氏覆盖邻域。费马距离是一种数据自适应的距离，能够反映数据点的底层分布。为了便于计算，我们构建了一个加权欧氏邻域图，并使用截断最短路径算法来计算费马覆盖图。我们还建立了充分条件，在该条件下这种构造能够精确地保持在完整数据上计算的费马覆盖。
tldr: 提出PC-Fermat方法，通过加权图上的截断最短路径算法以费马距离替代欧氏距离来构建覆盖邻域，从而在低预算主动学习中更好地捕捉数据的底层分布几何结构。
en_tdlr: Proposes PC-Fermat, a coverage-based active learning method that replaces Euclidean coverage neighborhoods with Fermat distance (computed via truncated shortest paths on a weighted graph), better capturing the underlying data geometry in the low-budget regime.
